test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which state became the first to pass a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) bill in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__

**__Key Points__**
__

• **Uttarakhand** became the first state in independent India to pass a **Uniform Civil Code (UCC) Bill** on **February 7, 2024**.

• The bill was passed by the **Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly** following a detailed report submitted by a five-member committee headed by retired Supreme Court Judge **Ranjana Prakash Desai**.

• The primary objective of the **UCC Bill 2024** is to establish a common legal framework for **marriage, divorce, land, property, and inheritance** for all citizens, irrespective of their religion.

• A significant feature of the bill is the mandatory registration of **live-in relationships**, with failure to do so potentially leading to imprisonment or fines.

• The bill specifically excludes **Scheduled Tribes (STs)** from its application, respecting the unique traditions and customary rights of tribal communities in the state.

**Additional Information__**

• **Article 44** of the **Indian Constitution**, which is part of the **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)**, states that the State shall endeavor to secure for the citizens a **Uniform Civil Code** throughout the territory of India.

• While **Goa** has followed a Uniform Civil Code (the **Portuguese Civil Code of 1867**) since its liberation, **Uttarakhand** is the first state to draft and pass its own UCC legislation after India's independence.

• The **President of India**, Droupadi Murmu, gave her official assent to the **Uttarakhand Uniform Civil Code Bill** in **March 2024**, making it an Act.

• The bill prohibits **polygamy** and sets a uniform age for marriage (18 for women and 21 for men) across all communities.
